name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pre-commit pytest black isort flake8
          # Install project dependencies if pyproject.toml or requirements exist
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
            pip install .
          elif [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt
          fi

      - name: Run pre-commit checks
        run: |
          pre-commit run --files setup.py README.md .pre-commit-config.yaml pyproject.toml .github/workflows/ci.yml .gitignore .flake8

      - name: Run tests with pytest
        run: |
          pytest -q
